description_en: Sets the automatic release time for a pay-as-you-go dedicated host or cancels its automatic release
description_zh: 调用ModifyDedicatedHostAutoReleaseTime为一台按量付费专有宿主机设定自动释放时间，或者取消自动释放一台按量付费专有宿主机
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-dedicated-host-auto-release-time --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-id dh-bp165p6xk2tlw61e0000 --auto-release-time 2019-06-04T13:35:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDedicatedHostAutoReleaseTime

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 专有宿主机所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the dedicated host.
parameters.description_zh: 需要自动释放的专有宿主机ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated host
parameters.help_zh: 需要自动释放的专有宿主机ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.description_en:
The automatic release time of the dedicated host. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

- The automatic release time must be at least 30 minutes later than the current time.

- The automatic release time can be up to 3 years earlier than the current time.

- If the value of the seconds (ss) is not 00, it is automatically set to 00.

- If `AutoReleaseTime` is not configured, the automatic release feature is disabled, and the dedicated host will not be automatically released.
parameters.description_zh:
专有宿主机的自动释放时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

- 必须晚于当前时间起算的半小时及以后。
- 必须早于当前时间起算的三年及以前。
- 如果参数值中的秒（ss）不是00，则自动取为00。
- 如果不输入`AutoReleaseTime`参数，表示取消自动释放，专有宿主机在预约时间点不再自动释放。
